split_policy: Use the official train, valid, and test directories without recursive split generation.
classification_branch_rule: Images with exactly one represented pathogen class receive a classification label. Multi-class images would be retained for localization and excluded from the classification loss.

mask_construction.polygon: Rasterized using pycocotools.frPyObjects and mask decoding.
mask_construction.bbox_fallback: Rectangle mask is used only when polygon/RLE geometry is unavailable.
mask_construction.overlap_rule: Larger annotations are written first so smaller annotated regions remain visible.
